Mature plants yield [[Ancient Fiber]] after 12 days. Seeds cannnot be purchased; they can only be obtained by digging up [[Stardew:Artifact Spots|Artifact Spots]] in the [[Secret Woods]] or by placing Ancient Fiber in the [[Stardew:Seed maker|Seed Maker]]. Mature plants will produce 2 – 4 Ancient Fiber per harvest with a 5% chance of extra produce per harvest and a 3% chance of extra harvest per each [[Stardew:Farming#Farming Skill|Farming Skill]] level. ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Ancient Fiber}} {{clear}}
